problem: The exact-head Required aggregator could wait forever for Powerhouse CodeQL on PRs that do not match the CodeQL workflow path filters, such as regulatory data-only candidates.
root_cause: The aggregator required a sibling workflow unconditionally even though that sibling workflow is intentionally path-filtered.
prevention: BRAIN remains mandatory for every pull request.
Determine CodeQL applicability from the pull request changed filenames using the same effective JS/TS, package and workflow path set as powerhouse-codeql.yml.
Require exact-head CodeQL completed-success only when CodeQL is applicable.
Record an explicit NOT_APPLICABLE proof when CodeQL is intentionally not triggered.
Reuse existing sibling workflow runs; never launch duplicate CodeQL work.
